main_text.l: in juvencis, est in equis Patrum virtus, &c. Patris mores imitatur filius, &c. Sic ergo redit probatio in orbem. Egregia sane ratio, quæ animos pertinaces nullo negotio convincat. Commenta revera inania hæc sunt, superstitiosorum ingeniorum, ultra Naturæ limites exorbitantium, ipsumque Naturæ lumen aspernantium: ut adeo liceat hic D. Mohyo sua verba reponere, quas allegato capite 7. objicit sanioribus Medicis: Has, inquiens, (proprietates, vel qualitates occultas, vel virtutes cœlestes quibus Sympatheticus ille Pulvis vulnera sanet, vel quocunque nomine appellare libuerit, nam vocabula non moramur,) bas, inquam & ego, veneramini ô Medicastri, qui Physicæ lumen aspernati in medicina postmodum cæcutientes, monstra & chimæras (verè monstra & chimæras) cimmerias parturitis, imaginationeque rusticâ rationes, quas nec vos ipsi, nec alius intelligit, effingitis. Quàm pulchrè quadrant ipsissima hæc verba

page.notes: Page is faint at the lower edge; the final line "in sui" is partly cut off by the bottom of the scan. Some marginal line-end text is illegible or uncertain, notably "ut adeo" and "cæcutientes". The reading of "Pulvis" and "bas" is doubtful.
